en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard. The picture side shows a street scene with many pedestrians and a horse cart in front of a large church with a tall clock tower and a cross on the roof, on a street lined with older houses. Printed Hungarian text at the top reads a greeting from Pécs and names the street. The reverse side is divided for address and message, with the printed Hungarian words for postcard, handwritten address and message in Hungarian cursive, and a green Hungarian stamp postmarked in the early 20th century.
